highlights.title: A closed question says who closed it
highlights.line: Hovering an agent's status says, for 12 hours, when its question for you was closed, and whether the agent or something else closed it.

highlights.title: An expired Claude login is said
highlights.line: An agent stopped by an expired Claude login shows a sign-in issue on its card; kosmos accounts says so, and agents are not moved onto it.

highlights.title: A printed sign-in message is not the agent's
highlights.line: When a command or MCP tool an agent runs prints "Not logged in", its card no longer reads that as the agent's own sign-in failure.

highlights.title: An old sign-in message no longer misleads
highlights.line: An old sign-in message left on an agent's screen no longer marks a Claude account as refused once it is signed in again elsewhere.
